description: Places an entry in a journal. An entry can belong to several journals.

main.description: Places an entry in a journal. An entry can belong to several journals. The record key is the journal's key and the entry's key joined by a colon (<journal>:<entry>), so a pair has exactly one membership and every device that adds the same entry to the same journal writes the same record.

createdAt.description: When the entry was added to the journal, when known. Two devices can add the same entry to the same journal at different times and write the same record; a device writes a membership create-only (createOnly), and when one is already present it leaves that record as it is, so the first createdAt written is the one every device sees. A device that later finds two copies with different createdAt values keeps the earlier.
